basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, who recently dived into the world of high-quality audio gear. I work as a junior web developer at a local startup and spend most of my evenings exploring new hobbies. I have a keen interest in gaming, especially strategy and FPS games, and I'm currently learning about audio customization to enhance my gaming experience. I live with my partner and our two cats, and I am mostly active online during late evenings and weekends. Besides technology, I am lactose intolerant, which has led me to explore dairy-free cooking.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of technology and audio equipment, primarily acquired through self-teaching and community forums. My knowledge is expanding as I learn more about audio customization for gaming.
